sources.title: USDA FSIS — Food Thermometers
sources.what: A food thermometer is 'the only reliable way' to confirm safe minimum internal temperature; whole poultry checked in three places (innermost thigh, innermost wing, thickest breast), avoid bone; do not stuff whole poultry for optimum safety; stuffing centre must reach 165°F. Also read 2026-11-20 (session ab951e4c): “Most food thermometers will give an accurate reading within 2 to 4 degrees F”; ice-water calibration (stem ≥2 in, ≥30 s, should read 32°F); boiling-water calibration (212°F at sea level, distilled water, 2–5°F lower at altitude, ask the local Cooperative Extension office); “If the thermometer doesn't allow manual calibration, you may need to replace it”; care wording (most thermometers should not be immersed; plastic faces can melt; do not leave in food unless designed for it); the types table (oven-cord/fork “Cannot be calibrated”, thermistor “Some models can be calibrated”, thermocouple “Can be calibrated”, wireless/smart designed to remain in food at ≥1 in deep and “more costly”; read times 2–5 s / 10 s / 1–2 min).
sources.access: Fourth read 2026-11-20 by session arena-70bd2fcc: page re-fetched live and the recorded claims re-confirmed verbatim. Second independent read on 2026-11-20 by session ab951e4c.

sources.title: Amazon Associates Program Policies — operating restrictions (§2–§6), verbatim detail read
sources.what: Clauses read on 2026-11-20 and not previously recorded in this register: §2(b) 'You must not make inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive or otherwise misleading claims about any Product, an Amazon Site, or any of our policies, promotions, or prices'; §2(b) requires 'additional original content' on the Site when a link points at a page with Product lists; §2(b) price rule again — 'your Site may only show prices and availability if: (a) we serve the link in which that price and availability data are displayed, or (b) you obtain Product pricing and availability data via Creators API or PA API'; §4 'You may include Special Links in emails, SMS and direct messaging from your social media Sites; provided, that such communications are solicited (i.e., opted into by the receiving customer)'; §5 'You will not, without or express prior written approval, use, or allow any third party to use, any Special Links or Program Content to develop machine learning models or related technology'; §6(a) 'You will not add to, delete from, or otherwise alter any Program Content in any way … except that you may … truncate Program Content consisting of text in a manner that does not materially alter the meaning of the text'; §6(c) 'You will promptly remove from your Site and delete or otherwise destroy any Program Content that is no longer displayed on an Amazon Site'; §6(d) no use of Program Content 'in a manner that implies a person's or company's endorsement or sponsorship of, or commercial tie-in or other association with, any product, service, party, or cause'.
